inputs.52.text: Modern high-end Japanese anime game cinematic key visual, sharp digital illustration with crisp thin lineart, realistic adult proportions, dramatic cel shading with hard-edged shadows, strong rim light, glowing bloom light effects, deep saturated color and high contrast. An Oklahoma farm in the 1930s Dust Bowl: a weathered farmhouse with a bare kitchen table visible through its open door, a sand-scoured metal farm windmill on the left, a towering brown dust storm rolling in like a wall from the right, a sepia sky, wide panoramic establishing view of the place standing empty and still.
